hook_text: NO WATER: WHAT HAPPENS HOUR BY HOUR?
comment: How much water do you really drink each day? 💧
title: What Happens to Your Body Without Water? Hour by Hour
short_title: What happens if you stop drinking water? 💧 #shorts
description:
Your body is about 60% water and loses some every minute. What actually happens, hour by hour, if you stop drinking? From the first signs of thirst to the danger zone around day three, plus sweat, camels, the 8-glasses myth, how much you really need, and why too much water can also be dangerous.

Educational content only, not medical advice. If you suspect severe dehydration, seek medical help.

Sources: U.S. Geological Survey (the water in you); EFSA, Scientific Opinion on Dietary Reference Values for water (2010); U.S. National Academies, Dietary Reference Intakes for water (2004); NHS (dehydration; hyponatremia); Mayo Clinic (dehydration); Guinness World Records (longest time without water); San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance (dromedary camel).
